WITH matched AS (SELECT b.id FROM books b WHERE text_grams(b.title) @> ARRAY[lower($1::text)]
     UNION
     SELECT ba.book_id FROM authors a JOIN book_authors ba ON ba.author_id = a.id WHERE text_grams(a.name) @> ARRAY[lower($1::text)])
     SELECT b.id, b.title, b.subtitle, b.publisher, b.year

WITH matched AS (SELECT b.id FROM books b WHERE text_grams(b.title) @> ARRAY[lower($1::text)]
     UNION
     SELECT ba.book_id FROM authors a JOIN book_authors ba ON ba.author_id = a.id WHERE text_grams(a.name) @> ARRAY[lower($1::text)]) SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM matched

WITH matched AS (SELECT b.id FROM books b WHERE b.title ILIKE $1
     UNION
     SELECT ba.book_id FROM authors a JOIN book_authors ba ON ba.author_id = a.id WHERE a.name ILIKE $1)
     SELECT b.id, b.title, b.subtitle, b.publisher, b.year
     FROM matched m JOIN books b ON b.id = m.id 
     ORDER
